data.long_meaning: Jon is a Hebrew name derived from the root yon, meaning 'dove.' In biblical texts, Jon is the name of a prophet who saves the city of Nineveh from destruction. The name Jon can be interpreted as 'God is gracious' or 'God has been gracious.'. The name Jon carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jon usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: The name Jon gained widespread recognition through the Old Testament story of the prophet Jonah. In popular culture, names like Jonathan, Jonas, and Jon have become common due to their rich heritage.
